historicalFinding.text: no cache clearing or allocator limit change; optional warm peak accounting reset has explicit before/after observations
historicalFinding.effect: Historical text contradicts real256MiB install and finish cache clear. Keep raw data; correct future frozen source only.

limits: All 1086 observations retained, fixed six known clean cases and strict existing content oracle only; no universal quality claim.
Nearest-rank p95 is ordered value29 of30; L is mean of six medians, warmup excluded. CPP baselines need not meet candidate absolute median target.
Cache may be slower than old FP16. Casewise directions and both orders are reported; no statistical equivalence or universal zero-slowdown claim.
Power is before, discrete approximately5-second samples and after confirmed reap; same observed AC/policy does not prove continuous thermal/load/physical conditions or Joules.
time-l RSS and physical footprint are whole-process maxima; they are not warmed-phase samples and must not be combined additively with historical phase RAM deltas.
loadMillis are observed fresh-process loading with existing OS caches; not cold-boot evidence.
Large models/binaries/kernel and two large nonruntime archived documents retain hashes/witnesses from frozen verified preparation; no large blob rehash.
caffeinateReaped receipt plus bound terminate/wait source proves reported child reap; its PID is not exported for a second independent PID check.
Historical RAM-v1 stale limits wording remains an open documentation finding in that unchanged report, whose allChecksPassed remainsfalse. Current pace checks are scoped separately.
